thread:
Asha (oncall): :rotating_light: noticing a bunch of high-latency pages for /v1/generate across us-west-2 around 11:10 UTC. noise mostly from 95th/99th token latency alerts. any one oncall?
Ben (SRE): I'm on. seeing a spike in tail latency, looks correlated with a batch of long-sequence jobs from a single customer. not seeing full outage, but pages are noisy.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4839 - High tail latency (auto-pager) — assigned to Asha (oncall).
Asha (oncall): cool. I'm going to triage and suppress non-actionable pages so we can focus. Leah, can you check if support has customer pings for errors?
Leah (support): no direct customer tickets yet. Customer success pinged one partner but they reported degraded response time in-app. no 5xxs.
Ben (SRE): digging into routing — looks like a small scaling blip on one dedicated pool + long sequences hitting KV cache miss. continuous batching is producing larger-than-usual batches, increasing tail latency.
Asha (oncall): plan: 1) silence lower-priority latency alerts for 2h so we can mitigate without more noise 2) add a temporary maintenance window for the dedicated pool 3) adjust the 99th -> temporary threshold if needed 4) follow-up postmortem. OK?
ops-bot: Creating silence: `opsbot silence add alert:llm_token_latency_high 2h --reason "post-incident cleanup / reduce noise"`
IncidentOps (bot): silence created for `alert:llm_token_latency_high` duration 2h by Asha.
Ben (SRE): I'll scale a couple of nodes in that dedicated pool to drain the long jobs, and add a short routing rule to divert new heavy sequences to lower-priority capacity.
Asha (oncall): do it. post the commands you run so we can audit.
Ben (SRE): ran scale command:```
# scale dedicated pool
redwoodctl pool scale --pool-id dp-usw-6 --min 6 --max 12
redwoodctl route update --name heavy-seq-backstop --target dedicated-burst
```
Ben (SRE): also temporarily relaxed the 99th percentile alert from 700ms -> 1.2s while we stabilize, using the UI -> alerts -> edit (rule id: latency-99-pct-usw).
Asha (oncall): noted. Leah, can you message CS to say we're mitigating, no customer-facing errors and we've reduced noisy pages?
Leah (support): done. pinged CS slack thread and emailed the handful of impacted partners with a short note.
Asha (oncall): adding a maintenance window to avoid further auto-pages during cleanup. ops-bot, add MW for dp-usw-6 2h.
ops-bot: maintenance window added: dp-usw-6 from 11:20 UTC for 2 hours (owner: Asha).
Ben (SRE): after scaling, tail latency came down ~45% in the next 10 minutes. dashboards updated.
Asha (oncall): good. starting quick validation suite against /v1/generate (sequence lengths 512/1024) to check thresholds are safe. Ben, paste the synthetic test commands.
Ben (SRE):```
# synthetic load run
siege -c 50 -t 5m "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?seq=512" 
# check 95p/99p in prometheus query: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(llm_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Ben (SRE): tests running now. initial pass looks good: 99p < 900ms at 512, ~1.05s at 1024 but stable.
Asha (oncall): ok we should tighten alerts back down but not to the pre-incident value yet. Proposed thresholds: 95p 450ms, 99p 900ms. Want to be conservative for 24h.
Leah (support): CS asked for a one-line summary they can share: can we provide "no customer errors, mitigation done, monitoring adjusted while we validate"?
Asha (oncall): yes. Send that.
Ben (SRE): creating a follow-up ticket in ENG-OPS: "Investigate KV cache miss pattern + batching anomalies -> permanent threshold/routing changes + dashboard". I'll include graphs and the synthetic results.
Asha (oncall): also add a short dashboard tile that shows per-customer sequence-length distribution and routing hit-rates — helps avoid blind spots.
Ben (SRE): added tile prototype to dashboard 'infra / latency / per-customer seq' and shared link in #eng-sre.
Leah (support): CS confirmed they will hold on notifying customers further, they appreciate the proactive update.
ops-bot: Reminder: silence for alert:llm_token_latency_high expires in 1h 45m.
Asha (oncall): before silence expires we need to validate threshold changes. Ben — can you snapshot current alert rule versions and post JSON here?
Ben (SRE): pasted rule diff:```
- alert: llm_token_latency_99p
- expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(llm_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.7
- for: 5m
+ alert: llm_token_latency_99p
+ expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(llm_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.9
+ for: 10m
```
Asha (oncall): good to keep longer `for` window while we observe. Also add a low-severity alert that fires if we see >3 customers with >50% tail latency over baseline — helps detect multi-tenant regressions instead of noisy single-customer spikes.
Ben (SRE): proto rule:```
alert: multi_customer_tail_regression
expr: count_values("customer", sum by (customer) (rate(llm_token_latency_bucket[5m]))) > 3
for: 15m
severity: warning
```
Asha (oncall): tweak the expr later, but good idea. Leah — can you add an entry to the incident notes for CS + support playbook updates? Add: "silence flow, MW usage, temporary threshold policy, customer comms"
Leah (support): adding to notes and will create a small KB for on-call handling of noise vs impact.
IncidentOps (bot): Incident INC-2026-4839 status changed to "Mitigated" by Asha (oncall).
Asha (oncall): I'll hand off to Ben for follow-ups and open the post-incident ticket for alert cleanup. Ben, you own the follow-up.
Ben (SRE): will do. I'll revert the temporary threshold to 99p 900ms in 24h if no regressions, and then we can propose a permanent rule after the postmortem.
Leah (support): marking support tasks done for now.
Asha (oncall): thanks team. Final: no customer-facing errors, noise suppressed, pool scaled and stabilized, temporary thresholds and MW in place, follow-up ticket created. I'll close the thread in a bit. :white_check_mark: :eyes:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4839 closed by Asha (oncall).
